notes: Tier A requires license.verifiedBy=human. pinnedCommit is the reviewed SHA, never a floating branch. Reference entries have no import button.

entries.title: Poseidon — FFT ocean
entries.notes: Tessendorf 3-cascade IFFT as WebGPU compute + TSL optics. No WebGL2 path upstream — wrapper must ship a fallback shader (RENDERING.md / PERFORMANCE.md). Extract compute+material out of the Vite demo shell.

entries.title: Gaia — procedural grass
entries.notes: Generation half is pure ESM (genome+seed, no Three import). Rendering half becomes InstancedMesh System. Zero authored assets — Open World template content source.

entries.title: Dryad — procedural trees
entries.notes: Same genome/seed split as gaia. Pin commit on next curator pass. Compatible design with gaia — wrap as sibling packages, not a merge.

entries.title: Demiurge — tectonic planet
entries.notes: Procedural mode for @3jse/terrain beside hand-authored heightfields. WebGPU-only; same fallback obligation as poseidon. Needs World Partition before it is load-bearing.

entries.title: Tiamat — SPH fluid

license.note: LICENSE file is standard MIT; GitHub detector fails on a leading BOM. Human must flip verifiedBy before Tier A.

entries.notes: 100k SPH particles, raymarched surface. Stage under /plugins/_vendor/tiamat/ until license.verifiedBy=human. Then wrap as FluidVolume feeding physics-rapier.

entries.title: Apate — surface relief comparison
entries.notes: Not a plugin. Port normal-map / POM / SPOM / displacement techniques into Material Graph nodes. Credit upstream.

entries.title: Minos — native planet engine
entries.notes: Different runtime (Rust/Vulkan). Algorithm reference for terrain + dryad port only. Zero code crosses into 3JSE.

entries.title: Chiro Elemental Sandbox — procedural ability VFX

forks.note: Upstream-submitted expansion fork; same MIT LICENSE text.

entries.notes: Vite demo shell: hand-written GLSL, GPU instanced particles, 10 abilities (radials, boosts, portals, linear cast). Pause-and-sculpt sliders are the interaction model the Phase 5 VFX graph should steal. Extract emitters+shaders; do not import the character controller or the 938-slider debug UI wholesale. GLSL not TSL — wrapper should retarget hot paths to TSL where PERFORMANCE.md requires a WebGPU path.

entries.title: Three-VFX — WebGPU particle system
entries.notes: GPU compute particles, curve-over-lifetime, multiple emitter shapes. Closer to an actual library than Chiro's sandbox. Read LICENSE.md on curator pass before any A promotion. Complements chiro-elemental (abilities) rather than replacing it (engine).

entries.title: Quantum Core — shader scene

license.note: CodePen snippet. No LICENSE file, no GitHub mirror found. Treat as all-rights-reserved until the author publishes a repo+license.

entries.notes: Look-dev reference for dense volumetric/core shader scenes. No import button. If a GitHub mirror with MIT/Apache appears, reopen as Tier B. Do not paste CodePen source into the engine.

entries.title: Kimodo — NVIDIA text-to-motion

license.weights: SOMA/G1 checkpoints: NVIDIA Open Model License (commercial-friendly). Kimodo-SMPLX-RP-v1: NVIDIA R&D Model — do not redistribute weights without that gate. Llama-family text encoder has its own HF terms.

entries.notes: Not a runtime plugin and not a Three.js codebase. Integration shape: editor tool that calls local or networked inference, writes an AnimationClip / VAT, retargets onto @3jse/character. Never ships weights inside a Publish build. Prefer SOMA-RP-v1.1 over SMPL-X-RP for license. C API surface is on the LocalAI port (kimodo-cpp), not this repo.

entries.title: kimodo.cpp — LocalAI GGML port

license.note: No LICENSE file in tree as of this pin. NOTICE present. Do not treat as Apache-2.0 by association with nv-tlabs/kimodo. Human must read NOTICE + any SPDX headers before staging.

entries.notes: CPU/Vulkan local inference, C API returns SMPL-X22 rotations + root translation, localhost demo on :8094. Future Tauri sidecar for the editor Motion panel — never in-page WASM until license is verified and a WASM build exists. Weights remain gated.

entries.title: WebGPU-Ocean — MLS-MPM / SPH fluid
entries.notes: Raw WebGPU (not Three.js). Useful as compute-pass reference beside tiamat. Wrapper would own the Three interop. Confirm LICENSE file on curator pass.

entries.title: HLS WebGPU terrain plugins
entries.notes: QuadTree LOD terrain + instanced grass + ocean plane on Three r184 WebGPU. License unverified — default B. Overlaps demiurge/gaia; pick one primary wrap per capability.

entries.title: Babylon Node Material Editor
entries.notes: Frame-node / preview / subgraph UX only. Port patterns into RENDERING.md Material Graph. Never import. Engine-coupled to @babylonjs/core.

entries.title: Babylon Inspector
entries.notes: Picking, property readout, draw-call stats — pattern for Viewport debug overlay. Never import.

rejected.reason: Commercial paid asset. 3JSE wraps permissively-licensed work or stages attributed source — it does not vendor proprietary store assets. Poseidon covers the same capability.
